steps.prompt: Before the check: which tool from this unit do you reach for fastest now, and which one do you still have to stop and think about?

cards.title: Solving quadratics: quick review
cards.body: Factor when you can: two numbers that multiply to $c$ and add to $b$; spot $a^2 - b^2$; never divide by $x$. Otherwise $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$. The discriminant $b^2 - 4ac$ says two, one or no real solutions.

cards.title: Roots, vertices and remainders: quick review
cards.body: Vieta: sum $= -\frac{b}{a}$, product $= \frac{c}{a}$; $r^2 + s^2 = (r + s)^2 - 2rs$. Vertex form $a(x - h)^2 + k$: the smallest (or largest) value is $k$, at $x = h = -\frac{b}{2a}$. The remainder of $p(x) \div (x - a)$ is $p(a)$, and $p(1)$ is the sum of the coefficients.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ AMC-style problems with choices, easiest first, no hints. You need all $8$ right (100%) to pass. If you miss one, you'll see the solutions and which skills to review, and the next try gives you new problems.
